sourceSheet.note: 12 original frames were cropped/padded into equal 256x256 slots without resizing artwork

notes: Idle overrides artwork only for female swordsman.
Attack and Hit use existing pose assets.
If the optional PNG is missing or invalid, game automatically falls back to original artwork.
The provided animated sprite is a fixed sword and armor appearance; per-equipment art layers are a future extension.
The original 12-frame asset must be uploaded to this branch separately; the 8-frame fallback runs at 12 FPS until it is available.
